name: Sonn-Alm Chalet-Apartments
beschreibung:
Overview

The Sonn-Alm Chalet-Apartments are located in the mountain village of Bichlbach in the Tyrolean Zugspitz Arena, at an altitude of around 1,100 metres on the Tyrolean side of the Zugspitze. The holiday apartments are run by Cornelia Müller-Hechenberger and Helmut Hechenberger. The apartments are furnished in a modern alpine style, lovingly and exclusively equipped, and are suitable for couples, families and groups of friends. A range of units in different sizes is available: a 30 m² studio for one to three people, 50 m² apartments for one to five people, units of 70 to 75 m² for two to six people, maxi-apartments of 85 to 90 m² for up to eight people, as well as large apartments of 120 m² and 130 m² for up to eight and eleven people respectively. Five of the apartments have a private Finnish sauna directly in the apartment. The apartments have fully equipped kitchens (including a JURA fully automatic coffee machine, dishwasher, oven), smart TVs and modern bathrooms; some units also have a private south-facing terrace, a garden and a Weber grill.

History/Background

The Sonn-Alm is presented as a family-run holiday apartment business managed by Cornelia Müller-Hechenberger and Helmut Hechenberger. Its own website documents the ongoing development of the property: for 2026 it is announced that all chalet apartments will receive new smart TVs in May and that the chalet apartment maxi of 85 m² (No. 4) will get a private Finnish sauna directly in the apartment in autumn 2026. This will further increase the number of apartments with their own sauna. More detailed historical information about the founding or conversions of the property is not documented on the website and is therefore not claimed here.

Arrival

The accommodation is located in Bichlbach in the Tyrolean Zugspitz Arena at the foot of the Zugspitze. The official contact address of the Sonn-Alm is A-6621 Bichlbach; the operators can be reached by phone at +43 676 9664 301 and by email at info@sonn-alm.at. The website contains a dedicated page for Contact and Directions. Specific information about road connections, public transport and parking should be requested directly via this contact page or from the operators; undocumented details about the route are deliberately not given here.

Tips

Dogs are welcome at the Sonn-Alm; the operators charge 10 euros per night, listed dogs are not allowed. Anyone wishing for a private sauna should book early, as only some of the apartments have a Finnish sauna in the apartment. In winter, skiers enter the Bichlbach-Berwangertal ski area directly from the village centre, and the Bichlbach ski school offers options for every ability level. In summer, clear mountain lakes, varied hiking trails and biking routes as well as family-friendly leisure activities beckon. Bookings are made via the property's own website in the “Book” section.

Best time to travel

The Sonn-Alm advertises stays in all seasons: spring, summer and autumn between mountains and lakes, and winter on the slopes or winter hiking in the snow. According to the operators, winter in Bichlbach is characterised by particularly reliable snow conditions. Those who want to hike and experience the mountain lakes should choose the warmer months; winter sports enthusiasts and sauna lovers will find suitable conditions in the cold season. Exact season dates or minimum stays are not stated on the website.
